metadata.article_title: Protection of action taken in good faith.

article.title: Protection of action taken in good faith.
article.content: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the Central Government or against the State Government or any officer or authority of Government or any other person for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act.
article.html:
22Protection of action taken in good faith.

Section 22 · Chapter V · page 17 of the Act

No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the Central Government or against the State Government or any officer or authority of Government or any other person for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act.
